purpose: Source-authored contracts for custom law profiles that require Inferno gating, sacrifice, or summon transaction identity. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.
requiredRuntimeProof: native gating entry or summon transaction proof
sacrifice transaction proof when sacrifice is accepted by the law
created or lost unit identity proof
temporary summon versus permanent recruited unit discriminator proof
law-owner and transaction-owner side correlation proof
spell cast or calendar trigger ordering proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: generic spell cast counted as gating/sacrifice/summon transaction
fire damage marker counted as summon or sacrifice
battle start or calendar tick counted as transaction identity
ordinary permanent casualty counted as temporary summoned loss
summoned unit existence without entry transaction proof
inferno.fire-gated-sign-calendar.notes: Requires real Inferno gating, sacrifice, or summon transaction identity before the calendar law can use first-fire or gated-sign behavior; spell casts and fire markers are companion evidence only.

forbiddenSubstitutes: generic spell cast counted as gating/sacrifice/summon transaction
static Primal school access counted as gated identity
fire damage marker counted as summon or sacrifice
ordinary permanent casualty counted as temporary summoned loss
summoned unit existence without entry transaction proof
inferno.primal-fire-gating-charge.notes: Requires real Inferno gating, sacrifice, or summon transaction identity before Hellfire Gatecraft can award runtime charges; native Primal access and spell casts are not the transaction proof.
